verdict.rationale: The axis clearly applies to a card-present terminal product like Stripe Terminal, but the evidence pack contains no mention of PCI DSS, PCI scope reduction, or vendor guidance on merchant compliance obligations — only unrelated features like receipts, refunds, tipping, offline storage, and Connect integration. Missing for 10: any documentation citing PCI scope reduction claims, certified reader/PCI validation details, or guidance on residual merchant PCI obligations.
